implementation: StackLayoutNode requires a non-empty dense canonical children array, valid generated fields, and a valid optional gap_token before layout-stack geometry is emitted.

Children render through recursive ProjectionLayoutRenderer calls in canonical order, retain the trusted registry, and expose bounded stack indexes without deriving a substitute contribution or layout.

The recursive guard rejects empty/omitted/foreign-keyed contributions, unknown renderer or semantic bindings, missing authority, duplicate node/contribution identities, shared or sparse child structures, non-index array members, malformed gap tokens, and unknown generated fields as one tree.

The renderer has no local layout store, resize/drag commit, eligibility resolver, Workstream authority resolver, stale watermark repair, capability inference, or generated operation replacement. Canonical layout mutation remains the generated focusa.mission_canvas.layout.mutate path in DesktopMissionCanvasRuntime.

negative_cases.empty_child_list: A StackLayoutNode with zero children produces no layout-stack, stack-child, layout-single, or contribution host.
negative_cases.ordered_children_and_nested_recursion: A valid two-child stack preserves first/second contribution order, gap_token, child indexes, and a nested stack's order; the nested custom binding proves the trusted registry is propagated recursively.
negative_cases.omitted_or_foreign_contribution: An omitted contribution ID or a DTO whose contribution_id is foreign to the map key rejects the entire stack before a valid prefix can reserve geometry.
negative_cases.unknown_renderer_or_semantic_binding: Unknown renderer bindings and non-allowlisted semantic bindings are rejected by the trusted registry; no generic or substitute panel is rendered.
negative_cases.missing_authority: Deleting a contribution AuthorityDescriptor rejects the stack before any child host or gap is emitted.
negative_cases.duplicate_or_malformed_tree: Duplicate node/contribution identities, empty/invalid gap tokens, sparse children, non-index array members, and unknown stack fields fail closed as a unit.
negative_cases.foreign_scope_stale_revision_cursor_unav: Exact Workstream/Attachment scope, stale projection/layout/cursor watermarks, and unavailable operation/capability paths remain enforced by generated transport and MissionCanvasProjectionController/EventClient seams already exercised by the same runtime test; Stack rendering does not infer, repair, or replace those authority checks.
negative_cases.ineligible_or_empty_contribution: Core omission diagnostics and the eligible contribution map determine occupancy. The stack renderer receives only that canonical set and refuses any layout reference that is absent or cannot resolve through the trusted registry.
negative_cases.resize_mutation: The stack renderer emits no resize control or local mutation. DesktopMissionCanvasRuntime owns generated layout mutation and supplies exact authority, expected projection/layout revisions, command, and idempotency fields to focusa.mission_canvas.layout.mutate.

acceptance: Empty child list is rejected and omitted children leave no gap.
Omitted contribution IDs cannot leave DOM nodes, headings, borders, or gaps.
Unknown semantic or renderer binding fails closed; no substitute panel is rendered.
Resize mutations call focusa.mission_canvas.layout.mutate rather than changing canonical layout locally.
